title: Traffic Accident Severity Prediction
summary: A machine-learning system trained on over seven million US accident records. It balances the data with undersampling and SMOTENC, then compares Random Forest, SVM and LightGBM under CRISP-DM.
points: Uses the US Accidents dataset from Kaggle, with over seven million accident records
Balances the data with random undersampling and SMOTENC, because minor accidents far outnumber severe ones
Compares Random Forest, SVM and LightGBM to find the best model, following the CRISP-DM framework
Planned interactive Power BI dashboard to show the predicted results

title: E2E Service Data System, SUK Kelantan
summary: A Laravel system for Kelantan state departments to submit service data, with role-based approval, email alerts, automatic reports and an audit trail.
points: Built during industrial training at the Information Technology Management Division, State Secretary Office of Kelantan
Three user roles: main administrator, administrator and reporter, so departments submit data and admins check it before it goes to the central administration
Email notifications, automatic report generation and charts for analysing the data
Role-based access and an audit trail that tracks user actions

title: FloraSense
summary: Smart plant monitoring: ESP8266 sensors feed Firebase, Gemini AI scores plant health, and Blynk shows live readings and controls the pump.
points: An ESP8266 reads temperature, humidity and soil moisture and uploads the data to Firebase
A Python program sends the readings to Gemini AI, which returns a health score, risk level and watering advice
The Blynk mobile app shows live readings and AI advice, sends alerts and lets users switch the water pump on and off
Tested on a real potted plant with an LCD display, relay and mini water pump

title: Half Full Cafe Ordering System
summary: An Oracle APEX ordering system for a Sungai Petani cafe, with separate dine-in and pickup orders and a sales dashboard.
points: Aims to cut waiting time, reduce order errors and separate dine-in from pickup orders
ERD and flowchart drawn in Draw.io, then the database and web app built in Oracle APEX
Dashboard with interactive charts for table usage, revenue by payment method and sales
Manages customers, inventory, staff, suppliers, menu, orders and payments, with 10 SQL queries

title: Skintific Review Sentiment Analysis
summary: Classified about 1,000 Shopee reviews of a moisturiser with TF-IDF features. Deep Learning reached 89.87% accuracy.
points: Collected and cleaned about 1,000 customer reviews, including English and Malay stopword removal
Turned the text into TF-IDF features and compared Random Forest, Naive Bayes and Deep Learning in RapidMiner
Deep Learning performed best with 89.87% accuracy and 69.07% precision
Tested on 49 unseen reviews, with about 92% agreement in a manual check

title: SmartJog AI
summary: An IoT app that ranks jogging routes by heat, humidity, distance and shade. I designed the app screens.
points: Proposed ESP32 and DHT22 sensors to measure temperature and humidity along jogging routes
Firebase stores the readings and a Flutter app shows live conditions and a route map
Routes are ranked by heat, humidity, distance and shade, and marked Suitable, Use Caution or Not Recommended with a reason
Designed the app screens, from login and home to the route map
